inclusionReview.note: The capture of HMS Penguin on 23 March 1815 is an individually reviewed naval engagement between Hornet and Penguin. The Naval Historical Center identifies the action off Tristan da Cunha; Peacock and Tom Bowline arrived after the fighting. The broad source classification naval warfare does not independently identify a battle. No exact offshore position has been established, so this newly catalogued engagement remains unmapped rather than being placed at the island centre.

note: Reviewed single-ship engagement: one USS Hornet opposed one HMS Penguin on 23 March 1815. The Naval Historical Center account places Peacock and Tom Bowline after the action; they are not combatants in this count. Penguin surrendered and was too badly damaged to save, while Hornet survived. Loss quantities count vessels lost to their original side, including capture; they are not crew deaths. No personnel total, human casualties or offshore coordinate is inferred. The engagement remains unmapped pending a source-backed position.
